assertions.assertion: The appeal is for the CO-197 denial
CPT 93229 is mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring
The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations, dizziness, and near-syncope that are intermittent and difficult to capture on standard ambulatory monitoring
The clinical suspicion of sick sinus syndrome (I49.5)
Prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended period
The service should be reviewed and covered as medically necessary
